blocks.text: 13C NMR spectrum 1H spectrum se saada hai: har peak carbon atom ke aik mukhtalif environment (qism) se mutaliq hai, aur us ki chemical shift batati hai ke kaun sa environment. Peaks ki tadaad mukhtalif carbon environments ki tadaad ke barabar hai. Ethane aik peak deta hai, kyunke dono carbons aik environment mein hain. Propane, CH3-CH2-CH3, ke do environments hain, do barabar sire wale CH3 carbons aur beech wala CH2 carbon, is liye do peaks deta hai. Ethanol, CH3-CH2-OH, bhi do peaks deta hai: Table 30.3 ke mutabiq 18 ppm wali peak CH3 carbon aur taqreeban 57 ppm wali oxygen se jura CH2 carbon hai.

blocks.alt: 13C NMR spectrum, ppm paimana 60 se 0: taqreeban 57 ppm par hari lakeer, taqreeban 18 ppm par gulabi lakeer, aur 0 par TMS. Inset mein ethanol ka khula formula HO-C-C-H: OH ke saath wala carbon hara, doosra gulabi.
blocks.caption: Figure 30.7: Ethanol ka 13C NMR spectrum (kitab mein 'Figure 30.3' chhapa; asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Hara carbon OH ke saath hai, is liye taqreeban 57 ppm par; gulabi CH3 carbon taqreeban 18 ppm par. Kitab mein is figure ke neeche ghalti se 'Figure 30.3' chhapa hai; text isay Figure 30.7 kehta hai, is liye hum ne Figure 30.7 likha hai.

13C aur 1H spectra do ahem tareeqon se mukhtalif hain. 13C NMR mein nisbati peak area aam taur par carbon atoms ki tadaad ke mutanasib nahi, 1H NMR ke baraks, jahan peak area protons ki tadaad dikhata hai. 13C peaks batte bhi nahi, is liye akeli khari lakeeron ki shakal mein aati hain. (Kitab mazeed kehti hai ke 13C NMR 1H NMR se kam hassas hai; yeh zyada tar is liye hai ke carbon atoms ka sirf taqreeban 1.1% 13C hai.)

blocks.prompt: Butane ke 13C NMR spectrum mein kitne signals mutawaqqa hain? Wajah dein.
blocks.explanation: Do: CH3-CH2-CH2-CH3 mutanasib hai, is liye do CH3 carbons barabar aur do CH2 carbons barabar hain.

blocks.prompt: Butan-2-ol ka 13C NMR spectrum predict karein.
blocks.explanation: Chaar peaks, CH3-CH(OH)-CH2-CH3 ke har carbon ki aik: C-O carbon 50-70 ppm (taqreeban 69) aur teen alkyl carbons 0-50 ppm (taqreeban 32, 23 aur 10).

blocks.prompt: Propanoic acid ke carbon atoms ki chemical shifts predict karein.
blocks.explanation: CH3CH2COOH ki teen peaks: COOH carbon 160-185 ppm, carboxyl group ke saath CH2 Table 30.3 ki 30-65 ppm had mein (amalan taqreeban 28 ppm) aur CH3 0-50 ppm (taqreeban 9 ppm).

items: 13C peaks ki tadaad = carbon environments ki tadaad.
Batna nahi; areas carbons ki tadaad ke mutanasib nahi.
